title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
title_zh: 面向对话式商品搜索的波斯语电商对话数据集自动构建
abstract_en: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full catalog, the RPB score needs 0.11 fewer turns than the strongest entropy baseline when the difficulty of answering differs between features, and is practically equivalent to it when it does not. Using only a free LLM API, we generated 1,000 requirement-driven dialogues covering all 170 clusters, with turn-level feature annotations; automatic checks and an LLM judge confirm their consistency with the catalog, while their realism is lower than that of the first, GPT-4o-generated version. Code and data are publicly available.
abstract_zh: 对话式商品搜索让用户通过多轮交流而非单次关键词查询寻找商品，但现有波斯语电商对话资源覆盖的品类较少、商品目录规模较小，难以支撑系统训练与评估。本文提出一种从真实电商目录自动构建对话数据集的框架，并公开了生成的数据集。框架从 Digikala 抓取 7 个品类的 12,926 件商品，将其划分为 170 个语义一致的簇，并使用 Regularized Partition Balance（RPB）评分逐轮选择助手应提出的问题。RPB 综合考虑属性覆盖率、用户能够回答的概率以及属性取值数量，是基于熵的提问策略的推广。随后，大语言模型（LLM）将提问计划转写为自然的波斯语对话。在全目录仿真中，当不同属性的回答难度不同时，RPB 比最强的熵基线平均少用 0.11 轮；当回答难度相同时，两者表现基本持平。研究仅使用免费 LLM API 就生成了 1,000 段由用户需求驱动的对话，覆盖全部 170 个簇，并提供逐轮属性标注。自动检查和 LLM 评审均显示对话与商品目录一致，但其真实感低于由 GPT-4o 生成的初版。代码与数据均已公开。
key_points_zh: 从 Digikala 的 7 个品类抓取 12,926 件商品，并划分为 170 个语义一致的商品簇。
RPB 逐轮选择提问，兼顾属性覆盖率、用户能够回答的概率和属性取值数量，而非只看熵。
全目录仿真显示：属性回答难度不同时，RPB 比最强熵基线平均少用 0.11 轮；难度相同时基本持平。
免费 LLM API 生成了覆盖全部商品簇的 1,000 段对话，并附逐轮属性标注；对话与目录一致，但真实感不及 GPT-4o 初版。代码与数据已公开。
